value.value: A thin NC film is deposited on glass; its edge is placed directly on a silicon pn photodiode. Cover the surrounding diode area opaquely, place it in a dark box and illuminate perpendicular to the glass center using a lens-collimated warm-white-like beam. The experimental film is unencapsulated, not a demonstrated polymer-embedded recipe.
